contracts.owner: Observation V3 input boundary; concrete runtime source remains unselected
contracts.required_input: One typed LiDAR snapshot carrying the exact shared identity and an angular scan before sectorization
contracts.runtime_evidence_boundary: ROS message type, driver, header source, range, geometry, extrinsic, cadence, latency, freshness, skew, timeout, and buffer evidence are not established by this abstract contract
contracts.static_semantics: Target frame is exactly lidar_frame with no inferred alias; observation representation produces exactly 72 finite sectors. No numeric sensor or timing value is selected.

contracts.owner: Navigation/global-path reference boundary; concrete provider remains unselected
contracts.required_input: One typed LocalReference snapshot carrying the exact shared identity
contracts.runtime_evidence_boundary: Path provider, source type, topic, transform evidence, freshness, and provenance are not established by this abstract contract
contracts.static_semantics: Source semantics are navigation/global-path reference expressed in base_link; output feature names and order are distance, sin_bearing, cos_bearing. Simulation sources are not runtime authority.

contracts.owner: EKF-owned fused-odometry semantic boundary; concrete publisher/config remains unselected
contracts.required_input: One typed measured-twist snapshot carrying the exact shared identity and vx, vy, wz components
contracts.runtime_evidence_boundary: Topic, message type, covariance, validity limits, freshness, source provenance, package/config pin, and measurements remain unresolved
contracts.static_semantics: Output components are base-frame vx, vy, wz. Invalid values fail closed; clipping, zero-fill, and fallback are forbidden. Simulated odometry is not runtime authority.

contracts.owner: Localization, EKF, and robot-description ownership boundaries
contracts.required_input: A typed static frame/TF ownership binding plus separately verified runtime transform evidence
contracts.runtime_evidence_boundary: Physical transform, extrinsic, alignment, publisher uniqueness, and freshness require separate measurement/runtime evidence
contracts.static_semantics: Target ownership is localization for map->odom, EKF for odom->base_link, and robot description/robot_state_publisher for base_link->lidar_frame; frame aliases are forbidden.

contracts.owner: SafetyLifecycle is sole owner of action/reset barriers
contracts.required_input: The exact lifecycle tuple and a final-issued receipt snapshot admitted under the existing receipt v2 authority
contracts.runtime_evidence_boundary: Barrier occurrences, timestamps, sequence values, receipt instances/payloads, freshness results, and lifecycle observations are runtime facts and are not static config/hash values
contracts.static_semantics: The tuple is episode_generation, reset_epoch, runtime_generation. Receipt requires exact tuple and an ingress-bound config_hash equality, is strictly after applicable action/reset barriers and not after observation cutoff. Receipt v2 and QoS6 authority remain unchanged; this manifest adds no field to the receipt message.

non_goals: no concrete profile source or resolved ObservationInputProfileV3 instance
no new ROS interface, message type, topic, publisher, package version, timeout, geometry, measurement, or runtime evidence
no change to the Architecture 16-root ResolvedConfig.config_hash policy
no root gate_b member or partial profile/hash
no Gate B pass, WP-04 closure, or code/runtime/HIL/hardware/deployment authorization
no Ground Truth in policy observation and no fabricated ROS odometry/TF/time in sim_train

runtime_boundary.adapter: Future separately authorized adapters must verify middleware type, QoS, frame, freshness, provenance, lifecycle, and barrier facts before creating typed input snapshots. Because receipt v2 is unchanged and has no config_hash field, the exact config_hash association is external ingress-binding semantics and is not defined as a message member here
runtime_boundary.core: Pure core accepts only typed, already-validated snapshots and emits no vector when any required input is missing, mismatched, stale, invalid, or unverifiable
runtime_boundary.sim_train: Only typed internal simulator facts through a separate boundary; it is not a runtime canonical source and must not leak ground truth into policy observation

shared_identity.comparison: Exact atomic equality across every runtime input and the receipt ingress context; no partial match, alias, default, coercion, or fallback
shared_identity.config_hash: Exact lowercase 64-hex global ResolvedConfig.config_hash bound to each typed snapshot and to the receipt ingress context outside the unchanged receipt v2 message
